task: Configure the shared cache (crates/blaze-remote): read the public bucket, push from CI, or keep a machine fully local
do: Local only is the default: with no `<state>/remote.json` and no BLAZE_CACHE_* variables, or with `{"enabled": false}` in remote.json, blaze contacts nothing; `blaze cache status` says what can leave the machine. To read the public cache: remote.json `{"bucket": {"public_url": "https://<public host>"}, "namespaces": [{"name": "public", "anchors": ["<anchor public key, 64 hex>"]}]}` (or BLAZE_CACHE_PUBLIC_URL and BLAZE_CACHE_PUBLIC_ANCHORS), then `blaze cache pull <toolchain> <target> std`. To push (CI only): BLAZE_CACHE_ENDPOINT, BLAZE_CACHE_BUCKET, BLAZE_CACHE_ACCESS_KEY_ID, BLAZE_CACHE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, BLAZE_CACHE_SIGNING_SEED (the builder's Ed25519 seed, 64 hex) and BLAZE_CACHE_KEY_LIST (a path to the key list), in the environment or `<state>/remote-credentials.json` (mode 0600, refused otherwise), never both. Keys: generate a seed with `openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519 -outform DER | tail -c 32 | xxd -p -c 64`; `blaze cache keys public` prints the public key of BLAZE_CACHE_SIGNING_SEED and of BLAZE_CACHE_ANCHOR_SEED; the anchor signs the key list offline with `BLAZE_CACHE_ANCHOR_SEED=<seed> blaze cache keys sign '{"namespace": "public", "serial": 1, "issued": <unix s>, "keys": [{"key": "<builder public>", "roles": ["build", "root"], "from": <unix s>, "until": <unix s>}], "out": "<path>"}'`. A new key list needs a higher serial. The workflow .github/workflows/cache-push.yaml names the repository variables and secrets it reads, and skips green while they are missing. Tests: `blaze test -p blaze-remote` (the fake bucket; nothing contacts a service).
why: The settings, their two sources, the key ceremony and the local-only default are spread over settings.rs, cmd.rs and the workflow; this is the one place that says how to set them.
